en.use: Build automations from prompts and visual workflows, or create documents and lightweight apps in chat
en.limits: Access is sales/demo-led; pricing and customer-specific activation dates aren't stated. Some financial-data connectors remain planned

zh.use: 云端任务可在合上电脑后继续，也能跨桌面、网页和手机查看；不依赖本机文件的定时任务无需设备在线

en.what: Claude's long-running task workflow changes execution location for Pro/Max today
en.change: New tasks run in the cloud and the local-only option disappears; already-started local tasks can continue
en.use: Cloud work can continue with a closed laptop and be reviewed across desktop, web and mobile; schedules without local dependencies need no online device
en.limits: Local files still require an open desktop app and connected folders. Local projects and schedules don't transfer directly to Claude Code

event.summaryZh: Reka 公开可实时引导的视觉/动作研究原型
event.summaryEn: Reka unveils a steerable visual/action research prototype
event.deltaZh: 10月5日研究预览把连续视频生成、指令理解与机器人动作通道放进同一模型；示例为模拟环境
event.deltaEn: The October 5 preview combines continuous video generation, instructions and robot action channels in one model; shown robotics examples are simulated

zh.what: Reka 的 19B 多模态研究原型，演示理解、生成视频与动作的闭环
zh.change: 可在持续生成的视频中插入指令；机器人示例展示 LIBERO 模拟中的观察、预测腕部视图与动作通道
zh.use: 作为交互模拟环境和视觉—动作研究的方向；官方通过联系团队讨论合作
zh.limits: 不是成品机器人或验证过的实地部署；长序列会结构漂移，视频定位与编辑仍脆弱，原生视频上限672×384

en.what: Reka's 19B research prototype demonstrates a shared loop for understanding, video generation and actions
en.change: Instructions can steer a continuous generated scene; robotics examples expose observations, predicted wrist views and action channels in LIBERO simulation
en.use: A direction for interactive simulation and vision-action research, with access/collaboration through the team's contact route
en.limits: Not a finished robot or proven physical deployment. Long rollouts drift structurally, temporal grounding/editing remain brittle, and native video is capped at 672×384
